comment: FabricRails as the agent reports it in HostSettings, whether the Controller raises network.rails-underused (cases), and how the agent reads NCCL's lines from a loading workload's log tail (logs; observed is null while a line is missing). The Rust agent test reads every case through the generated contract and every log; the Controller test projects each case onto a node.
